# StarkRank

> Data-driven digital marketing agency specializing in AI search optimization, technical SEO, and performance media.

StarkRank is a Swiss-founded digital marketing agency focused on the DACH region, with operations in Switzerland (Basel-Landschaft) and Germany (Hannover). We help businesses become visible, cited, and recommended by AI-powered search engines and traditional search platforms. Operated by Datanalytico Feye (UID: CHE-220.283.724), a Swiss sole proprietorship.

## Services

StarkRank offers 18 specialist services organised into five pillars:

### Search & AI Intelligence
- [AI Search Optimization](https://starkrank.com/services/ai-search-optimization/): Visibility audits and citation strategy for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Bing Copilot. Includes the proprietary AISO Score framework.
- [Technical SEO Audit](https://starkrank.com/services/technical-seo-audit/): Crawl analysis, Core Web Vitals assessment, structured data validation, and AI crawler access verification.
- [Local SEO Consulting](https://starkrank.com/services/local-seo-consulting/): Google Business Profile optimisation, NAP+W consistency, LocalBusiness schema, and review management.

### Performance Media
- [Performance Ads Management](https://starkrank.com/services/performance-ads-management/): Full-funnel paid media strategy across Google, Meta, and programmatic channels.
- [Google Ads Management](https://starkrank.com/services/google-ads-management/): Campaign setup, optimisation, and scaling for Search, Shopping, Display, and YouTube.
- [Google Ads Audit](https://starkrank.com/services/google-ads-audit/): Account review identifying wasted spend, missed opportunities, and quick wins.
- [Paid Social Strategy](https://starkrank.com/services/paid-social-strategy/): Paid campaigns on Meta, LinkedIn, and TikTok aligned with business goals.

### Authority & PR
- [Digital PR Strategy](https://starkrank.com/services/digital-pr-strategy/): Earned media placements that build brand authority and generate high-quality backlinks.
- [Reactive PR](https://starkrank.com/services/reactive-pr/): Real-time media opportunities and journalist outreach for timely brand coverage.
- [Authority Link Building](https://starkrank.com/services/authority-link-building/): Strategic link acquisition from relevant, authoritative publications.

### Content & Copywriting
- [Content Marketing](https://starkrank.com/services/content-marketing/): Data-informed content programmes that build topical authority and drive organic growth.
- [SEO Copywriting](https://starkrank.com/services/seo-copywriting/): Search-optimised copy that ranks and converts.
- [Copywriting Audit](https://starkrank.com/services/copywriting-audit/): Review of existing copy for clarity, conversion, and search performance.
- [Audience Persona Mapping](https://starkrank.com/services/audience-persona-mapping/): Research-driven personas that inform content, messaging, and targeting.

### Data & Web
- [Technical Web Design](https://starkrank.com/services/technical-web-design/): Performance-first website design built for speed, accessibility, and search.
- [Google Analytics Consultancy](https://starkrank.com/services/google-analytics-consultancy/): GA4 setup, custom reporting, and data analysis.
- [Performance Web Development](https://starkrank.com/services/performance-web-development/): Fast, accessible, and SEO-friendly web development.
- [ROI Reporting & Transparency](https://starkrank.com/services/roi-reporting-transparency/): Clear dashboards connecting marketing spend to business outcomes.
